summary: A parent, Sambo Shimanski, is seeking information about the Finnish child care system to find a place for their 3-year-old child. The child has been staying at home for two weeks, and the parent is concerned about the lack of proper childcare arrangements. The parent is currently residing in Rotaniyami, Finland. The advisor, Sambo, confirms that kindergarten would be a suitable option for a child of that age and asks for the parent's residential area to narrow down available options. The parent mentions they are a "holiday man" and do not have a permanent residence, which may affect eligibility for certain services. The advisor notes that they will take time to remember the parent's surname and will write it down for reference. Next steps include further discussion about available childcare options in the Rotaniyami area.

questionnaire.Position in labour market: Outside the labour market (eg.: stay-home-parent, retiree)
questionnaire.Any Additional Information: The customer mentioned their child is three years old and currently sitting at home all day, having been in this situation for two weeks. They expressed concern about finding a government-run kindergarten that offers free services and is located near their workplace in Central Espoo. They also noted that their child only speaks Chinese and are looking for options that provide language support.
